title: Which laptop should I buy?
instructions: Bir öğrenci iki dizüstü bilgisayarı karşılaştırıyor. Hangi özelliğin hangi bilgisayara ait olduğunu karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Hi. I'm a student, and I need a laptop for university. What's the difference between these two?

script.speaker: a
script.text: The Swift is lighter, only one kilo, and the battery lasts twelve hours. It's six hundred pounds.

script.speaker: a
script.text: The Power is faster and has a bigger screen, but it's heavier, about two and a half kilos. It's eight hundred.

script.speaker: b
script.text: I'll carry it to university every day, and I mostly write essays and watch lectures.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Then the Swift is better for you. The Power is good for games and video editing.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Yes, ten percent with your student card.
